name: BTCZ Ventures
decision_note: Prague private holding (formerly XENO Ventures s.r.o.) owned by a family holding and Liechtenstein Anstalts; its life-science startup stakes (2022-2023) appear only in a PitchBook profile that cannot be retrieved, so investing (I2) and activity cannot be shown from public sources.
analyst_notes: Second-pass screen. The candidate was listed as 'BTCZ Ventures / BD Partners', but ARES shows two unrelated entities: BTCZ Ventures s.r.o. (IČO 05277817, Evropská 11, Praha 6, est. 2016, renamed from XENO Ventures s.r.o. in 2017; partners B3 Holding, s.r.o. (IČO 24267392, Brůžek family), Cheval Finance s.r.o. and NP Finance s.r.o. (both owned by Liechtenstein Anstalts); registered activity is general trade and real-estate rental) and BD Partners a.s. (Bartoníček/Duvieusart, own dossier bd-partners). BTCZ's investing is known only from a PitchBook profile (HTTP 403, not verifiable; search snippet: Prague VC founded 2016, healthcare/life-science, 3 portfolio companies incl. Sampling Human and DIANA Biotechnologies 2022, Taveren Therapeutics 2023; co-investors Longevitytech.fund, i&i Prague, Formic Ventures, Valhalla Ventures). No website and no press mention was found in one search, and the web-search quota ran out before a second check. Type private_investor is provisional (own-capital holding structure); if confirmed it would be S1 anyway, and no in-window activity is known. The co-investor names come from the unverified PitchBook snippet.
